original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚最后一名埃博拉患者出院，启动42天无埃博拉倒计时
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚卫生部长宣布最后一名埃博拉患者已出院，该国正式开始42天倒计时，若期间无新增感染即可被宣布为无埃博拉国家。肯尼亚10月共记录9例埃博拉病例，首例患者经乌干达从刚果输入，其中2人死亡、7人康复。与此同时，刚果疫情持续蔓延，累计感染11042人、死亡5387人，乌干达和尼日利亚也出现输入病例。

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚最后一名埃博拉患者出院，开始42天无埃博拉倒计时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya's Health Minister Aden Duale announced on Wednesday that the last Ebola patient was discharged, with which the country officially began it's 42-day countdown toward being declared Ebola-free

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚10月记录9例埃博拉病例，首例患者经乌干达从刚果输入
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The country recorded nine Ebola cases in October after the first patient traveled from Congo through Uganda, transmitting the virus to four family members and four healthcare workers.

key_facts.fact: 首例患者及其母亲死亡，其余7名患者康复
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The first patient and his mother died of Ebola, while the other seven patients have fully recovered.

key_facts.fact: 刚果累计感染11042人、死亡5387人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In Congo, the epicenter of the outbreak, 11,042 people have been infected and 5,387 have died, the government said Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: 疫情经刚果旅行者扩散至乌干达和尼日利亚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The outbreak also spread to Uganda and Nigeria through individuals who traveled from Congo.

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Africanews）报道，尚未获得交叉验证
肯尼亚能否在42天内被宣布为无埃博拉国家取决于期间是否出现新增感染
